wu: Simon Says feelings: Teacher says 'Simon says show me happy' and students smile, 'Simon says show me sad' and students frown. After 3 rounds, teacher asks 'How are you?' and students shout 'I am happy/sad!'
wuAlt: Flashcard drill: Teacher holds up happy/sad/angry/tired cards, students say the word and make the face
Mime game: Teacher mimes feeling, students guess 'You are tired!'
pres: Teacher shows a puppet, says 'Hello, I am Sam. How are you?' Puppet replies 'I am happy!' Then 'How are you?' 'I am sad!' Teacher points to mouth when speaking, gestures to students to repeat. Checks by asking 'Show me happy?'
presAlt: Storybook: Read 'The Feelings Monster' where monster changes expressions, ask 'How is the monster?' after each page
Realia: Show a banana and say 'I am hungry!', ask students to bring food and say 'I am hungry!'
prac: Pair chain: Students stand in pairs, A asks 'How are you?' B answers 'I am happy!' then asks 'How are you?' A answers 'I am sad!' and so on, switching after 4 turns. Teacher circulates to help pronunciation.
pracAlt: Board race: Two teams race to write 'I am ___' under happy/sad/angry/tired flashcards on the board
Ball toss: Teacher throws a ball, asks 'How are you?', student catches and answers, then throws back
ls: Listen and match: Teacher plays 4 short dialogues ('How are you? I am happy!', etc.), students point to matching emotion flashcards on their desks. Check by holding up each card and asking 'Is this happy?'
re: Feelings charades: After break, teacher acts out tired (yawns), angry (stomps), happy (jumps), students shout the word and copy the action
prod: Mini-book making: Students fold paper into 4 pages, draw a face on each page (happy/sad/angry/tired), write 'I am ___' under each. Then walk around and read to 3 partners: 'This is me. I am happy!'
rw: Trace and copy: Students trace 'happy' 'sad' 'angry' 'tired' in dotted letters, then copy them 3 times. Then write 'I am ___ today' and fill in one word with a drawing
st: Song: Sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It' with clapping/stomping, then goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line
g: Students cross out happy/sad/angry/tired as teacher calls them
Match feeling cards with face cards
Run to board and write 'I am ___' under correct flashcard
Roll a die with feelings, say 'I am ___'
Act out feeling for team to guess
diff: Fast finishers: Draw a 5th feeling (hungry) and write a sentence
Support: Use word bank with pictures to copy from
hw: Cut out 5 feeling pictures from magazines, glue and label them
Draw 4 feeling faces and write 'I am ___' under each
Ask 3 family members 'How are you?' and write their answers
tip: Use the puppet for shy students – they’ll talk to the puppet instead of you. Link feelings to local context: 'After Eid, we are happy!'
